missed.maker: onsemi (datasheet NUP4114/D; JLCPCB maker label 'onsemi'); allowlisted as onsemi (S1)
missed.why: P2 considered only the SC-88 part, NUP4114UCW1T2G, and dropped it on rule 5. That drop holds: Digi-Key re-read at 2026-09-28T17:52:30Z gives 0 in stock, 58 weeks, Active. The TSOP-6 part of the same datasheet has stock at both vendors. The datasheet is NUP4114/D Rev. 8, December 2021, https://www.onsemi.com/pdf/datasheet/nup4114-d.pdf; the copy P2 fetched at 17:16:48Z was re-read. Its ordering table lists NUP4114HMR6T1G (TSOP-6, marking P4H) with the SC-88 and SOT-563 parts, under one electrical table. TSOP-6 STYLE 12 is pin 1 I/O, 2 GROUND, 3 I/O, 4 I/O, 5 VCC, 6 I/O. That is one placement for D+, D-, CC1 and CC2 on the I/O pins, with VBUS on pin 5, a shunt clamp outside the 3 A path. The table gives VRWM 5.5 V max, VBR 5.5 V min and 6.5 V typ, and IEC 61000-4-2 +/-8 kV contact and +/-15 kV air. CJ is 0.6 pF max I/O to GND and 0.3 pF max between I/O pins. VC is 10 V max at 8 A, pin 5 to pin 2, 8/20 us. TJ is -40 to +125 C. For V12, Figure 1 ('ESD Clamping Voltage Screenshot, Positive 8 kV Contact per IEC61000-4-2', 10 V/div, 20 ns/div; page 2 viewed) reads about 17 V at 30 ns, typical. P2 accepted the same kind of reading for VBUS54CV-HSF (its Fig. 8, about 15 V), so its note that NUP4114's 16 A TLP clamping 'is not stated' does not set it apart from its rank 2. It shares rank 2's drawback: the I/O steering diodes go to pin 5, so a driven D+ or CC line conducts into an absent VBUS. JLCPCB, vendors.py jlcpcb C260431, 2026-09-28T17:49:11Z: stockCount 7986, canPresaleNumber 7954, expand. Rule 4 passes. Digi-Key, vendors.py digikey NUP4114HMR6T1G, 17:49:23Z: stock 15000, lead time 25 weeks, Active. Rule 5 passes at the second vendor. SZNUP4114HMR6T1G is the same package: Digi-Key 3608, 99 weeks, Active (17:52:32Z); not in the jlcparts copy. Maker status: https://www.onsemi.com/PowerSolutions/product.do?id=NUP4114 redirects to https://www.onsemi.com/products/discrete-power-modules/esd-protection-diodes/nup4114 (HTTP 200, 17:51:59Z), which lists NUP4114HMR6T1G as Active. That page's parametric table gives 'V RWM Max (V)' 5 for NUP4114HMR6T1G and NUP4114UPXV6T2G, but 5.5 for NUP4114UCW1T2G and SZNUP4114HMR6T1G. The datasheet gives 5.5 V for the series. The re-rank records this disagreement against the VBUS stand-off of V10. exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: 'lines covered' asks that the protection cover 5 lines. It does not ask for one part. P2 qualifies two- and three-placement solutions for this function (rank 3 TPD4E05U06 x 2, rank 4 TPD4E1U06 x 2, rank 5 TPD2E2U06 x 3). A TPD6S300 plus one VBUS clamp covers VBUS, D+, D-, CC1 and CC2 in two placements, as rank 3 does. The datasheets P2 fetched (SLVSDK3C, revised January 2017; SLVSDD6B, revised November 2016) were re-read from P2's copies on 2026-09-28. Section 7.3: IEC 61000-4-2 on C_CC1, C_CC2, D1 and D2 (TPD8S300: D1 to D4) is +/-8000 V contact and +/-15000 V air, meeting V9. Dx VRWM_POS is 5.5 V, above the 3.63 V of V12. Dx CIO is 1.7 pF typ and delta-CIO 0.02 pF typ, within V11. JLCPCB, vendors.py jlcpcb: C2649810 has stockCount 17564 and canPresaleNumber 17559 (2026-09-28T17:49:13Z).
